questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My students are / waiting for / their flights / at the gate no. 6.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the segment at the gate no. 6, the usage of "no." is incorrect.
 
• The **correct term** should be "gate number 6" instead of "gate no. 6".(गेट नंबर 6)
 
• The abbreviation** "no." **is not **suitable for formal **or written context **when specifying gate numbers in locations such as airports.**
 
• Therefore, **instead of "at the gate no. 6," **the correct phrase should be** "at gate number 6."**

Correct sentence: ***My students are waiting for their flights at gate number 6.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waiting for** (इंतजार कर रहे): Proper usage with no errors.

 
 
• **Example:** She is waiting for the bus.
 
 
 
• **My students are** (मेरे छात्र हैं): Proper usage with no errors.
 
 
• **Example:** My students are very diligent.
 
 
 
• **Their flights** (उनकी उड़ानें): Proper usage with no errors.
 
 
• **Example:** Their flights were delayed.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I am very much / obliged of my friend / for the help / he rendered to me.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the fourth part of the given sentence, the preposition 'of' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the correct preposition should be 'to' instead of 'of'.
 
• The correct phrase is 'obliged to my friend' rather than 'obliged of my friend'.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence should be 'I am very much obliged to my friend for the help he rendered to me.'.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***I am very much obliged to__ my friend for the help he rendered to me*.**

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

She __will being studying __for her __exams tomorrow.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'will being' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **'will be studying'** to indicate a future continuous action.
 
• The structure for future continuous tense is **'will be' + present participle (verb+ing)**.
 
 
• **Example:** *She **will be studying** for her exams tomorrow.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be 'will be studying' instead of 'will being'.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***She will be studying __for her exams tomorrow*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The future continuous tense is used to describe actions that will be happening at a specific time in the future.
 
 
• **Example:** *At this time next week, I **will be traveling** to Paris.*
 
 
 
• It is formed using the auxiliary verb 'will' followed by 'be' and the present participle form of the main verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Memorable day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uneventful day** (अघटनापूर्ण दिन): A day when nothing significant or exciting happens.

 
 
• **Example:** Yesterday was quite an** uneventful day**; I just stayed home and watched TV.
 
 
 
• **Unimportant day** (महत्वहीन दिन): A day that does not have any significant importance or relevance.
 
 
• **Example:** It was just another **unimportant day** in my routine.
 
 
 
• **Regular day** (साधारण दिन): A day that is typical or routine with no special events.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a** regular day** at the office with the usual tasks and meetings.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

Namita still cannot _________ the pain of her cat’s untimely demise.
questions.solution:

__
 
• The word "bear" is a homophone that means to endure or tolerate.
 
• The other options are incorrect as they do not fit the context of the sentence:
 
 
• "bier" refers to** a frame or stand on which a corpse or coffin is placed.**
 
• "beer" is an** alcoholic beverage.**
 
• "bare" means **to be uncovered or exposed.**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct** homophone** to fill in the blank is "bear".

Hence, the correct statement is: ***Namita still cannot bear__ the pain of her cat’s untimely demise*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Homophones** are words that **sound the same but have different meanings and spellings**.

 
 
• **Example:** **"Write"** and **"Right" **are homophones.

• When the subject of a sentence is singular, the verb must also be singular to maintain subject-verb agreement.

• When the subject of a sentence is plural, the verb must also be plural to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
 
• Example: *The cats **sit** on the mat*.

questions.question:

They gave us the impression that Clara was a cold and __calculating__ woman, who was only after power.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"calculating"** means acting in a scheming and ruthlessly determined way. (चालाक और निर्दयी ढंग से कार्य करना)

 
 
• **Example: **His **calculating** nature made him very successful in the corporate world.
 
 
 
• **"Manipulative"** refers to exercising unscrupulous control or influence over a person or situation. (किसी व्यक्ति या स्थिति पर अनुचित नियंत्रण या प्रभाव का प्रयोग करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She was very** manipulative,** always finding ways to get what she wanted.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'calculating'** is **'manipulative'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Callous **(निर्दयी): Showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others.

 
 
• **Example:** His** callous** comments about the accident shocked everyone.
 
 
 
• **Unscrupulous **(बेईमान): Having or showing no moral principles; not honest or fair.
 
 
• **Example: **He was** unscrupulous** in his business dealings, often cheating his clients.
 
 
 
• **Unsympathetic** (असंवेदनशील): Not feeling, showing, or expressing sympathy.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **unsympathetic** to his situation and offered no help.
